purpose: Add the invite_lifecycle StructuredContent union member and its strict, fail-closed parse guard to app/src/lib/marmot/parseStructured.ts, establishing (and unit-testing) the parse-boundary guarantee that the payload's subject pubkey and the protocol-level senderPubkey are kept as two distinct, never-conflated values so downstream renderers (S4) resolve the announcement's author from senderPubkey only.

public_api.name: StructuredContent (union member addition)
public_api.description: New discriminated-union member. `pubkey` is the subject/invitee's canonical 64-char lowercase-hex pubkey — never an author/attribution field. Matches the InviteLifecycleContent seam contract in stories.json#seams[0].

public_api.name: parseStructured
public_api.description: Existing exported function, extended with one new strict guard branch. Unchanged signature. Returns the invite_lifecycle variant only when type === 'invite_lifecycle', event is exactly one of the 3-member enum, and pubkey matches /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/; otherwise falls through (eventually returning null for unrecognized/malformed content). The returned object is rebuilt from named fields only ({ type: 'invite_lifecycle', event, pubkey }) — never a widened `as StructuredContent` cast — so extra/spoofed properties never pass through.

owned_data: the invite_lifecycle strict parse guard branch
